title: aeschynomene triflora
intro: Aeschynomene triflora, commonly known as the "Sensitive Plant", is a perennial legume native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used in various folk medicines for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aeschynomene triflora may include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of fever. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
